sources.title: Virgin Islands Laws Online: scheduled maintenance notice
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government of the Virgin Islands' live legislation portal says access to eServices and websites is temporarily unavailable for scheduled maintenance through 24 August 2026.

sources.title: British Virgin Islands Tourism: Visa information
sources.publisher: British Virgin Islands Tourist Board & Film Commission
sources.officialityEvidence: The live BVI Tourism visa page publishes the named schedule, identifies it as updated December 2019, and separately limits its UK/US/Canada exemption to visitors holding one of those third-country visas.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of the countries listed below require a visa ... (updated Dec. 2019).

sources.title: British Virgin Islands Tourism: Customs and Immigration entry requirements
sources.publisher: British Virgin Islands Tourist Board & Film Commission
sources.officialityEvidence: The live BVI Tourism entry page says passports are required and directs visa-necessity questions to the BVI Government Chief Immigration Officer, but gives no nationality or document-class schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitors from some countries may also require a visa for entry.
